title: Metroid (Unity Remaster)
description: A faithful recreation of the classic Metroid experience, reimagined in Unity. This project focuses on capturing the essence of exploration and tight platforming that defined a genre.
contributions: I mainly worked on the movement mechanics, focusing on the player experience— camera movement and achieving a satisfying jump and running jump feel. I also developed the wall jump feature, which proved to be quite the challenge to get right.

title: Mystery Room Mania
description: Explore a decrepit facility with only a flashlight and your wits. A tense 3D puzzle platformer that challenges players to navigate through darkness and solve environmental puzzles.
contributions: Solo development project—I designed and implemented the entire game myself, from concept to completion. This includes level design, puzzle mechanics, lighting systems, and player controls.

title: Split Heist
description: A Puzzle Platformer where you play as a thief trying to steal valuable technology from a secure facility. Navigate the dangerous Aetherium laboratory and solve environmental puzzles to make your escape. Be warned, Aetherium is a shady organization and they will not take kindly to your intrusion.
contributions: Split Heist was the final project for 494. It was a colloborative project, built by a team of 5 developers. Split Heist took a lot of inspiration from my previous game Mystery Room Mania, and I wanted to create a game that was more polished and professional. I was primarily responsible for the game design, level design, and puzzle mechanics. This project also taught me the creative aspects of game development, working with composers and artists to create a cohesive game.
